description: The trading ranking: public traders by realized PnL, return or hit rate over a rolling window, with open value and balance per row. Few traders qualify; raise min_sales (default 5) to drop lucky one-sale records, and always show each row's `sales` beside its rank.

min_sales.description: Priced sales in the window needed to be ranked, 1-100 (default 5).

title: List top traders
